name: Playing The Lottery
overview: Scripture warns against the pursuit of quick wealth and the love of money, highlighting that wealth gained by vanity or haste is ultimately diminished or unpunished, as seen in Proverbs 13:11 and 28:20. The heart’s true treasure reveals its devotion, for one cannot serve both God and riches simultaneously (Matthew 6:21, 24). Instead, God honors faithful labor and compassionate giving, promising blessings to those who trust Him rather than chasing after abundance that never satisfies (Proverbs 19:17; Ecclesiastes 5:10).
